title: Political You: Current Statements batch
description: One monthly batch of recent, sourced, dated public statements from the four parties on each of the 7 quiz topics. Balance rules that JSON Schema cannot express (a topic is all four parties or none: a topic may be left out, but a topic that is present needs all four parties with an equal count of 1 or 2 each; at least one topic; the date window; SAMPLE markers) are enforced by workbench/validate_statements.py.

batchMonth.description: The month this batch was curated, YYYY-MM.

published.description: true only in the approved, live batch. The app ignores a downloaded file unless this is true.

sample.description: true only for placeholder data. Sample files must not be published, and every sample quote and speaker must contain the word SAMPLE.

notes.description: Optional free text for reviewers. Not shown in the app.

id.description: Unique in the batch. Suggested form: <batchMonth>-<topicId>-<partyId>-<n>, for example 2026-10-courts-justices-green-1.

topicId.description: Quiz topic (see data/topics.json). A topic may be left out for a month; if present it needs all four parties, 1 or 2 statements each, the same count for every party.

speaker.description: Person or body quoted, for example a named official or the party's national committee.

speakerTitle.description: Role at the time of the statement, for example 'Chair, Libertarian National Committee'.

quote.description: Exact words from the source, without surrounding quotation marks. Use an ellipsis (…) for cuts. No paraphrase.

date.description: Date the statement was made or published, YYYY-MM-DD. Must be within about 12 months of the batch.

sourceUrl.description: Primary or reputable source that shows the exact quote. https only.

sourceTitle.description: Title of the page or document and its publisher, for example 'Statement on the Supreme Court vacancy (Green Party US press release)'.

verifiedAt.description: Date someone opened sourceUrl and confirmed the quote word for word, YYYY-MM-DD. On or after date.
